title: SWGOH.exe over EALauncher.exe
notes: If you launch SWGoH.exe directly from the Highball library, Highball assumes that an error occurred during renderer selection—but that’s not the case. The app launches, and it’s best to ignore the error message by saying, “Show me the log,” and then closing it; otherwise, Highball would switch the renderer.

title: EA app
notes: Playing Star Wars Galaxy of Heroes. Left it running in the background for a few hours and the game was always ready to go when I wanted it to be.
